# ADR 0005 — Application catalog generated by Nix and verified at build time

Status: accepted (2026-11-14)

## Decision
Applications are declared in NixOS modules (`resilience.apps.<id>`) with an
absolute store path command, optional restricted command for Ultra-Stable,
a minimum mode, a beginner description and keywords. The module generates
`/etc/resilience/apps.toml` and **fails the build** if any command is not an
executable file. The TUI validates the file again (ids, non-empty argv, no NUL,
unknown fields rejected) and checks executability at runtime, showing
`[UNAVAILABLE]` instead of failing.

A missing or invalid catalog never prevents the TUI from starting: built-in
functions (handbook, notes, status, network, settings, power) still work.

## Consequences
+ No invented package names can ship: a wrong binary path breaks the build.
+ Editions are just different sets of enabled application groups.
